svg.title: Maipo Valley study map
svg.desc: Orientation map with representative study locations and selected rivers and towns. Country and state outlines are geographic context, not appellation boundaries. No vineyard parcels or elevation model are implied. 1: Maipo; 2: Puente Alto; 3: Pirque; 4: Isla de Maipo; 5: Talagante; 6: Buin; 7: Peñaflor; 8: Paine; 9: Santiago; 10: Rancagua; 11: Viña del Mar; 12: San Bernardo

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine

g.text: Natural Earth · GeoNames CC BY 4.0 · representative locations · no appellation boundaries
